LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS (10 visible):
- workday.hcm: HCM - compensation agents only, NO REST API for staffing data
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HCM - REST API: EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1 (READ payroll/compensation data). KEY AGENTS:
  * SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1 - WORKFORCE SKILLS ANALYSIS: monitors employee competencies, matches personnel skills to organizational needs, evaluates capability gaps, recommends targeted development/reassignment
  * PerformanceReviewCycleCoordinator:v1
  * CompensationPolicyAutomationEngine:v1
- sap.s4: ERP - MaterialReceiptInboundAPI, Procurement agents, OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine, AssetLifecycleChangeOrchestrator
- sap.crm: CRM - sales/marketing agents ONLY - NO performance analytics APIs
- sap.ehs: Safety/health - VendorComplianceAutomationOrchestrator, SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator
- sap.ariba: Procurement - PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI, VendorInvoiceReconciliation, SourceingCampaignAndAccountManagementAPI
- corp.itsm: IT service mgmt - agents ONLY - NO create API for maintenance submission
- emarsys.cx: CX/marketing - agents only
- my.mes: Manufacturing - EquipmentOEEAnalytics, ProductionQualityMonitor
- siemens.plm: PLM - SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator, EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning (allocate-inventory capability), BOMComplianceValidator
- sap.odm: Data model (entity taxonomy only)

KEY FINDING: SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1 is THE resource for workforce capability assessment, skill gap analysis, and training recommendations for product line transitions.

args.reason: This agent directly analyzes workforce skills inventory, identifies engineering requirements via engineering change requests, evaluates capability gaps, and recommends targeted development actions for product line transitions.
